title: Learning from Contrastive Prompts: Automated Optimization and Adaptation
problem: Error-only prompt optimization overfits failures and existing prompts degrade when models or languages change.
assumption_broken: Prompt improvement need not learn only from failures or restart from scratch after a model change.
operational_signature: Generate alternatives → score outcomes → contrast extremes → synthesize and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting high- and low-scoring prompts alongside error feedback guides synthesis without specializing solely to failures.
limitations_evident: Unstable optimization across iterations
Small training sets without validation splits
Adaptation can weaken source-model strengths

title: CriSPO: Multi-Aspect Critique-Suggestion-guided Automatic Prompt Optimization for Text Generation
problem: Single-metric feedback inadequately guides prompt optimization for nuanced text generation.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimizers can discover their own critique dimensions and optimize prompt structure rather than only fixed instruction text.
operational_signature: Generate outputs → discover flaws → suggest edits → synthesize and score alternatives
load_bearing_mechanism: A receptive optimizer conditions on historical multi-aspect critiques and actionable suggestions to explore more effective prompts.
limitations_evident: Potentially high API-token cost
Automatic generation metrics have limitations
Experiments limited to summarization and QA

title: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Agent Framework for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Fixed agent pipelines and meta-learning routines restrict the space of discoverable agent designs.
assumption_broken: The optimizer and its permitted actions need not remain fixed while the agent improves.
operational_signature: Inspect implementation → propose changes → execute and assess → recursively revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Runtime monkey patching lets the agent rewrite both its task policy and its self-improvement logic.

improver_modified.how: The agent can rewrite its recursive decision and modification modules at runtime.

limitations_evident: Self-modification can terminate optimization
Fourteen percent of robustness trials finish worse than initialization
Unrestricted agents can call stronger models

title: AutoDAN-Turbo: A Lifelong Agent for Strategy Self-Exploration to Jailbreak LLMs
problem: Manually specified adversarial strategies limit automated red-team diversity and reuse.
assumption_broken: The strategy repertoire can be discovered and expanded rather than fixed by human designers.
operational_signature: Explore alternatives → evaluate responses → abstract improvements → retrieve and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful response improvements are summarized into a reusable strategy library indexed by prior responses.
limitations_evident: High multi-model compute demand
Repeated interactions needed to build the library
Main evaluation reuses requests seen during lifelong learning

title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
problem: Manual agent design and unstructured code search fail to efficiently reuse successful agent components.
assumption_broken: Agent components from separate systems can be standardized and recombined rather than optimized as inseparable designs.
operational_signature: Standardize components → recombine and evolve → predict promise → evaluate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Standardized module interfaces enable evolution and recombination while an in-context surrogate filters costly evaluations.
limitations_evident: Search constrained to four module interfaces
Predictor can miss promising designs
Evaluation remains expensive

title: From Exploration to Mastery: Enabling LLMs to Master Tools via Self-Driven Interactions
problem: Ambiguous and inaccurate human-centric tool documentation prevents reliable LLM tool use.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation can evolve from autonomous execution experience rather than remain a fixed human-written interface.
operational_signature: Explore diverse uses → execute trials → analyze discrepancies → rewrite and stop on convergence
load_bearing_mechanism: Tool execution feedback drives iterative documentation rewrites with diversity constraints and adaptive stopping.
limitations_evident: Evaluation restricted by budget
Excessive rewriting introduces redundancy and overfitting
Stronger backbone yields better documentation

title: StraGo: Harnessing Strategic Guidance for Prompt Optimization
problem: Failure-focused prompt rewriting introduces regressions on previously correct examples.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization should preserve positive experiences and receive actionable strategies rather than only error descriptions.
operational_signature: Analyze successes and failures → formulate strategies → cross revised candidates → evaluate and cache
load_bearing_mechanism: Balanced positive and negative experience analysis generates stepwise strategies whose prompt revisions are crossed over.
limitations_evident: Best of five prompts chosen using test performance
Matched searches do not establish token-cost parity
Proprietary model changes affect reproducibility

title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
problem: Manual workflow construction and inefficient automated search limit effective agent deployment.
assumption_broken: Workflow topology and prompts can be searched jointly in code rather than fixed before prompt tuning.
operational_signature: Select past design → edit structure → execute repeatedly → propagate experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Tree-structured experience ties code modifications to execution feedback and guides future workflow expansion.
limitations_evident: Workflow transfer depends on executor model
Repeated validation evaluations increase search cost
Search uses predefined operators to improve efficiency

title: Agent-as-a-Judge: Evaluate Agents with Agents
problem: Outcome-only evaluation misses intermediate agent failures while expert manual evaluation is costly.
assumption_broken: Evaluation can itself use agentic investigation rather than a single LLM judgment or final success metric.
operational_signature: Decompose requirements → inspect artifacts and traces → retrieve evidence → judge fulfillment
load_bearing_mechanism: A modular evaluating agent gathers project and trajectory evidence for requirement-level judgments.
limitations_evident: Mutual agent-judge improvement is prospective, not demonstrated
Human consensus is not absolute ground truth
Evaluation limited to 55 AI development tasks

title: Can Large Language Models Invent Algorithms to Improve Themselves?: Algorithm Discovery for Recursive Self-Improvement through Reinforcement Learning
problem: Human-designed model improvement algorithms constrain autonomous model advancement.
assumption_broken: A model can learn to generate its own improvement algorithms rather than merely apply fixed human algorithms.
operational_signature: Generate algorithms → apply to parameters → evaluate models → preference-train generator
load_bearing_mechanism: Development-set scores of executable merging algorithms supply preference pairs for DPO refinement of the algorithm factory.

improver_modified.how: DPO updates the algorithm factory weights using preferred versus rejected generated algorithms.

limitations_evident: Only mathematical reasoning evaluated
Transfer models share the Mistral architecture
Non-executable algorithms and timeouts removed before scoring

title: CoPS: Empowering LLM Agents with Provable Cross-Task Experience Sharing
problem: Reflection lacks novel experience and naive retrieval can introduce distribution-mismatched trajectories.
assumption_broken: Experience sharing need not be task-local or depend on manually curated demonstrations.
operational_signature: Collect experiences → match distributions → sample successful trajectories → act and store
load_bearing_mechanism: Pessimism-inspired retrieval balances successful experience utility against distance from the current task distribution.
limitations_evident: Memory quality and diversity determine effectiveness
Sensitive to retrieval hyperparameters
Theoretical decoder and pretraining assumptions may not hold

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration Networks for Software Development
problem: Static human-designed multi-agent workflows cannot adapt to diverse software requirements.
assumption_broken: Agent prompts and collaboration topology can be revised for each test-time task.
operational_signature: Generate implementation → test against proxy → attribute failures → revise collaboration graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Textual backpropagation converts execution failures into agent-level prompt and topology changes.
limitations_evident: Relies on correct automatically generated proxy tests
Network evolved separately for each task
Software benchmark covers only games and websites

title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
problem: Open web agents lack training tasks and dense feedback and suffer online policy drift.
assumption_broken: The training curriculum can evolve from current failures instead of staying a predefined task set.
operational_signature: Generate tasks from failures → filter difficulty → collect rewarded trajectories → constrain policy updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-seeded adaptive curricula combine with outcome rewards and KL-constrained reinforcement learning to sustain improvement.
limitations_evident: Learned reward model can misjudge completion
Evaluation restricted to WebArena-Lite
Task feasibility filtering uses GPT-4o

title: LLMs as Continuous Learners: Improving the Reproduction of Defective Code in Software Issues
problem: Issue reproducers fail to learn recurring general and repository-specific reproduction conventions.
assumption_broken: Repository expertise can accumulate through editable textual experience rather than weight fine-tuning or static examples.
operational_signature: Attempt reproduction → inspect execution trajectory → distill lessons → update hierarchical experience
load_bearing_mechanism: A reflection agent maintains general and repository-specific experiences using add, remove, merge, endorse, and modify actions.
limitations_evident: Dialogue-level lessons remain overly general
Generated reproducers may miss boundary conditions
Evaluation depends on LLM and human judgments

title: REVOLVE: Optimizing AI Systems by Tracking Response Evolution in Textual Optimization
problem: Immediate textual feedback can stagnate or oscillate without accounting for response changes over time.
assumption_broken: Textual optimization can use response trajectories rather than only current critiques.
operational_signature: Execute candidate → critique outcome → compare response evolution → refine and validate
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-assessed similarities across successive responses augment textual gradients to detect stagnation and instability.
limitations_evident: Second-order behavior is an analogy rather than a computed Hessian
Guidance can underperform when evaluator is weaker
Limited gains on saturated tasks

title: How to Correctly do Semantic Backpropagation on Language-based Agentic Systems
problem: Existing graph optimizers misassign output feedback by ignoring interacting neighboring inputs.
assumption_broken: Backward feedback must depend on heterogeneous sibling inputs rather than treating them independently and symmetrically.
operational_signature: Execute graph → condition feedback on neighbors → aggregate directions → propose and gate updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Neighborhood-conditioned semantic gradients preserve dependency information when assigning component-level improvements.
limitations_evident: Graph topology remains fixed
No guarantee that semantic gradients improve performance
Some baseline results could not be reproduced

title: Boosting Private Domain Understanding of Efficient MLLMs: A Tuning-free, Adaptive, Universal Prompt Optimization Framework
problem: Small multimodal models struggle with private domain distributions while fine-tuning demands excessive data and compute.
assumption_broken: Private-domain adaptation can optimize prompts and reuse search priors instead of tuning model parameters.
operational_signature: Search strategy combinations → reuse reward priors → diagnose representative failures → refine prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Transferred strategy-search priors warm-start error-distribution-guided reflective prompt optimization.
limitations_evident: Many API calls still required
Strategy pool requires human definitions
Private benchmark labels partially originate from GPT-4o

title: Toward Intelligent and Secure Cloud: Large Language Model Empowered Proactive Defense
problem: Static cloud defenses struggle to adapt to heterogeneous and changing denial-of-service threats.
assumption_broken: Defense actions and reusable experience can be generated and updated at runtime without retraining.
operational_signature: Collect observations → infer defensive actions → validate and deploy → evaluate and remember
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory-based feedback loop reuses effective defenses and avoids ineffective actions while generating missing mechanisms.
limitations_evident: Evaluation limited to three synthetic DoS scenarios
Trusts cloud monitoring and management infrastructure
Complex real-world threat adaptation remains future work

title: The Prompt Alchemist: Automated LLM-Tailored Prompt Optimization for Test Case Generation
problem: Generic test-generation prompts lack diversity, error guidance, and project context.
assumption_broken: Different LLMs require different test-generation instructions and learned error-avoidance rules.
operational_signature: Extract context → diversify instructions → cluster failures → induce and validate rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Diverse instruction search combines with execution-validated concise rules distilled from recurring test failures.
limitations_evident: Development bugs also included in test set
Only five Java projects evaluated
Coverage does not establish defect-detection effectiveness

title: ChemAgent: Self-updating Library in Large Language Models Improves Chemical Reasoning
problem: Chemical reasoning suffers cascading calculation errors and cannot reuse analogous past solutions.
assumption_broken: Task solutions can become reusable atomic memories that evolve during inference instead of being discarded.
operational_signature: Decompose query → retrieve analogous units → verify and refine → store new solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: A self-updating library of planning and execution memories supplies reusable subtask solutions for chemical reasoning.
limitations_evident: Memory quality strongly affects accuracy
Mixed-quality memories can confuse models
Compute limits prevent larger-scale memory experiments

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
problem: Static retrieval cannot maintain evolving conversational facts and their temporal relationships.
assumption_broken: Agent memory should preserve validity timelines and historical contradictions rather than overwrite static text summaries.
operational_signature: Ingest episodes → resolve entities and facts → invalidate temporal conflicts → retrieve relevant context
load_bearing_mechanism: A bi-temporal knowledge graph preserves source episodes while updating fact validity and retrieving compact contextual evidence.
limitations_evident: Combined conversation and business data capability untested
Single-session assistant questions regress
MemGPT comparisons limited by reproduction difficulties

title: Enabling Autonomic Microservice Management through Self-Learning Agents
problem: General-purpose LLMs lack service-specific operational knowledge needed for autonomic microservice management.
assumption_broken: Agents can discover service configurations through curriculum-driven interaction instead of relying on supplied documentation.
operational_signature: Generate curriculum tasks → execute plans → refine with collective feedback → curate reusable skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive environment exploration produces validated operational solutions consolidated into a reusable skill library.
limitations_evident: Prototype limited to Sock Shop
More complex systems remain untested
LLM limitations constrain reliable autonomous management

title: Multi-Agent Design: Optimizing Agents with Better Prompts and Topologies
problem: Joint prompt and topology design creates a large coupled search space for multi-agent systems.
assumption_broken: Topology search should not precede effective local prompt optimization or ignore global prompt interdependence.
operational_signature: Optimize local instructions → prune topology space → search compositions → optimize globally
load_bearing_mechanism: Three staged local-to-global optimization passes condition topology search on improved prompts and then retune their interactions.
limitations_evident: Topology space restricted to predefined building blocks
Ten-agent cap bounds explored systems
Optimization is dataset-specific

title: Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agentic Supernet
problem: Static multi-agent workflows waste resources and cannot adapt their architecture to query difficulty and domain.
assumption_broken: A dataset needs one fixed optimal agentic architecture rather than a query-conditioned distribution of architectures.
operational_signature: Sample a conditional composition → execute → score utility and cost → update distribution and operators
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint cost-aware distribution learning and textual operator updates yield query-dependent workflows with early exit.
limitations_evident: Search constrained to layered operator supernet
Performance depends on cost penalty and sampling count
Some experimental numerical details are absent from supplied text

title: ScoreFlow: Mastering LLM Agent Workflows via Score-based Preference Optimization
problem: Discrete search over fixed workflows limits adaptive workflow generation and scalable optimization.
assumption_broken: Workflow optimization must select one static structure rather than train a problem-conditioned generator.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → execute and score → form weighted preferences → train generator
load_bearing_mechanism: Score-DPO uses quantitative score gaps in preference sampling and the ranking objective to train an adaptive workflow generator.

improver_modified.how: Score-DPO updates the workflow generator weights after each round of execution-scored preference collection.

limitations_evident: Requires generator fine-tuning on GPUs
Evaluation noise remains a motivating concern
Workflow space relies on predefined operators

title: EvolvingAgent: Curriculum Self-evolving Agent with Continual World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
problem: Long-horizon embodied agents struggle to select useful experiences and update world knowledge without forgetting.
assumption_broken: Experience curricula and world knowledge need not remain fixed or require human construction.
operational_signature: Plan → act and verify → prioritize experiences → update predictive knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage curriculum selection prioritizes subtasks and experiences for continual world-model updates with forgetting regularization.
limitations_evident: Real-robot transfer remains future work
Verifier threshold can cause premature or delayed termination
Advanced Minecraft tasks retain low success rates

title: Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization
problem: Prompt optimization relies on costly external labels and many evaluation samples.
assumption_broken: Prompt quality must be measured against external references rather than relative output quality.
operational_signature: Rewrite → execute → compare outputs → retain preferred candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Pairwise LLM judgments of outputs provide reference-free prompt selection while outputs guide subsequent rewrites.
limitations_evident: Judge quality and domain biases limit optimization
Longer optimization can overfit sample questions
Cross-model prompt transfer remains future work

title: EvoFlow: Evolving Diverse Agentic Workflows On The Fly
problem: Single homogeneous workflows cannot efficiently serve queries with diverse domains and difficulty.
assumption_broken: Automated workflow design should converge to one performance-maximizing homogeneous architecture.
operational_signature: Retrieve parents → recombine and mutate → execute and score → select within niches
load_bearing_mechanism: Cost-and-utility niching preserves a diverse Pareto-oriented population of heterogeneous workflows instead of one costly winner.
limitations_evident: Larger populations raise per-query cost
Many parents can overwhelm LLM recombination
Depends on utility tagging and initial operator pool

title: AGrail: A Lifelong Agent Guardrail with Effective and Adaptive Safety Detection
problem: Fixed safety policies fail to adapt to diverse agent actions and may either miss risks or block legitimate behavior.
assumption_broken: Safety checks need not remain manually specified and static during deployment.
operational_signature: Retrieve checks → revise → validate and filter → persist checks
load_bearing_mechanism: An Analyzer and Executor collaboratively refine action-keyed safety-check memory using reasoning and optional environment tools.
limitations_evident: Relies on off-the-shelf LLM reasoning rather than trained guardrails
Limited specialized security tool availability
Weaker models are sensitive to input order

title: LLM Agents Making Agent Tools
problem: Scientific code repositories require labor-intensive environment setup and adaptation before agents can use them as tools.
assumption_broken: Agent tools must be manually integrated or generated entirely from scratch.
operational_signature: Install and snapshot → implement → execute and assess → diagnose and revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Captured installation actions and environment resets make closed-loop debugging produce reproducible repository-backed tools.
limitations_evident: Benchmark repositories were manually verified as installable
One example invocation may omit important edge cases
Unit-test success does not establish clinical reliability
